data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 frames safety as an 'intensional property (about the operation's internal execution not producing harmful side effects)' and idempotency as 'extensional.' This intensional/extensional split is not grounded in published definitions as the problem requires. The standard Alpern-Schneider definition of safety is a property that holds on every finite prefix of an execution trace — it is defined over observable execution histories, not over internal implementation details. Characterizing safety as 'intensional' about 'internal execution' misrepresents the published definition the problem asks to draw on.
